newsitem.title: CHINA: KA WAH MULLS HOLDING COMPANY STRUCTURE.
newsitem.headline: KA WAH MULLS HOLDING COMPANY STRUCTURE.

text.p: Ka Wah Bank Ltd said on Thursday it was considering a proposal which would make the company a wholly-owned subsidiary of a new holding company to be incorporated in Bermuda.
The shares of the new holding company would be listed on the stock exchange through an introduction and Ka Wah Bank shares would be delisted, the company said in a statement.
Ka Wah Bank shareholders would become shareholders of the new holding company, maintaining the same stake in the new company as they had in Ka Wah Bank.

"The proposal is prompted by management's desire to put into place an efficient corporate structure for its banking and related financial operations and to facilitate any future expansion of its business without affecting the existing operations of the company and its subsidiaries," Ka Wah Bank said.
It said any decision would be subject to approval from necessary regulatory authorities and shareholders.
Shares in Ka Wah Bank surged HK$1.45 to close at HK$10.90 on Wednesday.
